mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admission ( admission_id, patient_id, bed_id, admission_date, discharge_date, status, active ) VALUES ( #{admissionId}, #{patient.patientId}, #{bed.bedId}, #{admissionDate}, #{dischargeDate}, #{status}, #{active} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
a.admission_id, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date, a.status, a.active AS admission_active,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age AS patient_age, p.gender AS patient_gender, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.active AS patient_active,
b.bed_id, b.availability, b.active AS bed_active,
w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.ward_type, w.bed_charge, w.active AS ward_active
FROM admission a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN bed b ON a.bed_id = b.bed_id
JOIN ward w ON b.ward_id = w.ward_id
WHERE a.admission_id = #{admissionId}

SELECT
a.admission_id, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date, a.status, a.active AS admission_active,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age AS patient_age, p.gender AS patient_gender, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.active AS patient_active,
b.bed_id, b.availability, b.active AS bed_active,
w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.ward_type, w.bed_charge, w.active AS ward_active
FROM admission a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN bed b ON a.bed_id = b.bed_id
JOIN ward w ON b.ward_id = w.ward_id
WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId}
AND a.status = 'ADMITTED'
AND a.active = TRUE

SELECT
a.admission_id, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date, a.status, a.active AS admission_active,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age AS patient_age, p.gender AS patient_gender, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.active AS patient_active,
b.bed_id, b.availability, b.active AS bed_active,
w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.ward_type, w.bed_charge, w.active AS ward_active
FROM admission a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN bed b ON a.bed_id = b.bed_id
JOIN ward w ON b.ward_id = w.ward_id
WHERE a.bed_id = #{bedId}
AND a.status = 'ADMITTED'
AND a.active = TRUE

SELECT
b.bed_id, b.availability, b.active,
w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.ward_type, w.bed_charge, w.active AS ward_active
FROM bed b
JOIN ward w ON b.ward_id = w.ward_id
WHERE b.availability = 'AVAILABLE'
AND b.active = TRUE
AND w.active = TRUE
AND w.ward_type = #{wardType}
ORDER BY b.bed_id
LIMIT 1

SELECT
a.admission_id, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date, a.status, a.active AS admission_active,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age AS patient_age, p.gender AS patient_gender, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.active AS patient_active,
b.bed_id, b.availability, b.active AS bed_active,
w.ward_id, w.ward_name, w.ward_type, w.bed_charge, w.active AS ward_active
FROM admission a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN bed b ON a.bed_id = b.bed_id
JOIN ward w ON b.ward_id = w.ward_id
WHERE a.active = TRUE
ORDER BY a.admission_date DESC
